Hello everyone, I am Anjali, and I organize business trips to China for hospital groups. Let me explain how our trips work. The flights, the hotels and the main visits are always booked before you leave. So, if your itinerary says that you are visiting a factory on Tuesday at nine, that is fixed, and the host is waiting for you. But every delegation also has some free time, and my advice is to decide early what you are going to do with it. Some people are going to rest, and that is fine, because jet lag is hard in the first two days. Others are going to visit a showroom or meet a partner. Just tell me a week before, and I will try to organize it.

Hello Luciana, this is Wei Zhang from the international sales team in Shenzhen. I am calling about your visit next month. Everything is ready on our side. My colleague is picking up your group at the hotel at eight thirty on Tuesday, and we are starting the factory tour at nine. After lunch, we are showing you our new cameras in the showroom. In the evening, our director is having dinner with the delegation. We are also bringing an interpreter, so the doctors in your group can ask questions in Portuguese. I have one question for you: are you going to bring your engineers? If yes, please send me their names before Friday. Thank you, and see you soon.

I went to China with a hospital delegation last year, and next spring I am going to do it again. This time, I am going to do three things differently. First, I am going to study the list of companies before the trade show. There are too many booths, and last year I walked for two days without a plan. Second, I am going to bring more business cards. I gave away two hundred in three days! And third, I am going to arrive one day early. My flight is already booked: I am leaving Paris on a Friday, and our first meeting is on Monday. That gives me time to recover from the jet lag.
